scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn staunlabor.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8002
scripts.check: npm-run-all -s check:versioning check:security check:deadcode check:frontend check:backend
scripts.check:versioning: node scripts/check-version-sync.cjs && BASE_SHA=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null || true) node scripts/check-commit-range.cjs
scripts.check:security:backend: cd backend && uv run --no-sync python -I -m eifi1_server_kit.dependency_audit
scripts.check:frontend: cd frontend && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
